parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the objects whose tags you want to query. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

*   ResourceGroup: resource group. This is the default value.
*   Account: member.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-tag-resources --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --resource-id rg-aekz6bre2uq0000 --resource-type ResourceGroup --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'rg-aekz6bre2uq0000' --Tag.1.Key k1 --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value v1 --ResourceType ResourceGroup --method POST --force
